issue_context.title: Make the TabViewItemHeader a custom control
issue_context.body:
We on the team have been discussing this for a while, but I think we need to just bite the bullet on it finally.

We've been hacking things into the `TabViewItem`'s `Header` for a while now, but we're just constantly doing it at runtime. This is not the best - we probably need to have a custom control for it. This control would include:


* the tab renamer text box
* the zoom indicator (#6989)
* the progress indicator (#8133)
* The bell/mute icon
comments:

review_comments: nit: we did lose the comment that we'll use the current value in the box when the box loses focus. I remember in the past there was some discussion as to whether losing focus should "cancel" vs "commit" the change, and the comment is handy to know that we did settle on "commit" as the behavior here.
